source.name: Escape must close the suggestion list without erasing what the user typed
source.scope: Open upstream bug (https://github.com/TarekRaafat/autoComplete.js/issues/402) at 4bc4bad6da87b4546cf70a248553e4e4b03672a6, unfixed when pinned. Routing Super, then Ultra.

journey.title: Dismiss suggestions with Escape while editing a saved city
journey.goal: Escape closes the suggestion list and keeps the city the user typed

functionalJourney.title: Pick a suggested city with the pointer
functionalJourney.goal: Typing part of a name and clicking a suggestion saves that city

guards.title: ArrowDown and Enter still select a suggestion
guards.goal: Typing Fa, ArrowDown and Enter saves Faro

plan.root_cause: The Escape key handler in the navigation listener clears the input value (ctx.input.value = ''), causing the typed city to be lost when the suggestion list is dismissed.
plan.repair_strategy: Remove the line that clears the input value in the Escape case of the navigate function in listController.js, while keeping the clear event emission and list closure so that the list closes and the input retains the user's typed value.
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: Escape will close the suggestion list without modifying the input value, preserving user input and returning focus to the input field, satisfying WCAG 2.1.1 (keyboard) and 2.4.3 (focus order).
functional_risks: Any code that relied on the input being cleared when Escape is pressed may now see the retained value; however the clear event is still emitted, allowing listeners to react appropriately.
If other parts of the application expect the input to be empty after Escape for form reset purposes, they may need to adjust, but the requirement is to keep the typed value.
verification_requirements: After typing a value into the city input and pressing Escape, the suggestion list must be hidden (no visible #city-list).
The input must retain the typed value (form-data city matches the typed string).
Focus must return to the #city input after Escape.
ArrowDown and Enter selection of a suggestion should still function as before.
Tab selection (if enabled) should still work.
The clear event should still be emitted for any listeners that depend on it.
